addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- Explore: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

attachment.content:
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a GitHub pull request; for your working diff use /code-review
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

1	name: Deploy to Coolify
2	
3	on:
4	  push:
5	    branches: [main, develop]
6	    paths-ignore:
7	      - "**/*.md"
8	      - "docs/**"
9	      - ".claude/**"
10	      - ".github/skills/**"
11	      - ".vscode/**"
12	      - ".cursor/**"
13	      - "LICENSE"
14	  workflow_dispatch:
15	    inputs:
16	      skip_e2e:
17	        description: "Skip E2E tests (faster deploy)"
18	        type: boolean
19	        default: false
20	      skip_tests:
21	        description: "Skip ALL tests (lint + typecheck still run)"
22	        type: boolean
23	        default: false
24	      skip_ci:
25	        description: "Skip entire CI — deploy immediately (emergency only)"
26	        type: boolean
27	        default: false
28	
29	concurrency:
30	  group: deploy-coolify-${{ github.ref }}
31	  # Cancel superseded deploys. Coolify has a known stuck-build bug class
32	  # (coollabsio/coolify #5850, #6414, #6579) where overlapping Next.js
33	  # builds on the app server can wedge one build "In Progress" forever,
34	  # which in turn blocks Coolify's automatic Docker cleanup from running
35	  # and fills the disk. Cancelling in-flight deploys on a newer push is
36	  # safer than queueing them.
37	  cancel-in-progress: true
38	
39	# Explicit least-privilege permissions (security best practice)
40	permissions:
41	  contents: read
42	  actions: read
43	
44	env:
45	  NODE_VERSION: "22"
46	  IS_PRODUCTION: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' }}
47	  DEPLOY_URL: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'https://www.esdeveniments.cat' || 'https://staging.esdeveniments.cat' }}
48	
49	jobs:
50	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
51	  # Quality gate: lint + typecheck (always runs unless skip_ci)
52	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
53	  quality:
54	    name: Lint & Typecheck
55	    if: ${{ !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.skip_ci) }}
56	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
57	    timeout-minutes: 15
58	    steps:
59	      - name: Checkout repository
60	        uses: actions/checkout@v7
61	
62	      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
63	        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
64	        with:
65	          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
66	          cache: yarn
67	
68	      - name: Enable Corepack (Yarn 4)
69	        run: corepack enable
70	
71	      - name: Install dependencies
72	        run: yarn install --immutable
73	
74	      - name: Lint
75	        run: yarn lint
76	
77	      - name: Type check
78	        run: yarn typecheck
79	
80	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
81	  # Unit tests (skipped when skip_tests or skip_ci)
82	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
83	  unit-tests:
84	    name: Unit tests
85	    if: >-
86	      !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
87	        (inputs.skip_tests || inputs.skip_ci))
88	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
89	    timeout-minutes: 15
90	    steps:
91	      - name: Checkout repository
92	        uses: actions/checkout@v7
93	
94	      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
95	        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
96	        with:
97	          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
98	          cache: yarn
99	
100	      - name: Enable Corepack (Yarn 4)
101	        run: corepack enable
102	
103	      - name: Install dependencies
104	        run: yarn install --immutable
105	
106	      - name: Run unit tests
107	        env:
108	          CI: true
109	        run: yarn test
110	
111	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
112	  # Build + E2E tests (skipped when skip_e2e, skip_tests, or skip_ci)
113	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
114	  e2e-tests:
115	    name: Build & E2E tests
116	    if: >-
117	      github.ref_name == 'main' &&
118	      !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
119	        (inputs.skip_e2e || inputs.skip_tests || inputs.skip_ci))
120	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
121	    timeout-minutes: 30
122	    steps:
123	      - name: Checkout repository
124	        uses: actions/checkout@v7
125	
126	      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
127	        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
128	        with:
129	          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
130	          cache: yarn
131	
132	      - name: Enable Corepack (Yarn 4)
133	        run: corepack enable
134	
135	      - name: Install dependencies
136	        run: yarn install --immutable
137	
138	      - name: Generate service worker and robots.txt (prebuild)
139	        env:
140	          BUILD_VERSION: ${{ github.sha }}
141	          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
142	          NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://www.esdeveniments.cat
143	        run: yarn prebuild
144	
145	      - name: Build Next.js application
146	        env:
147	          NODE_ENV: production
148	          HMAC_SECRET: ${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
149	          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
150	          NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://www.esdeveniments.cat
151	          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
152	        run: yarn build
153	
154	      - name: Install Playwright browsers
155	        run: npx playwright install chromium --with-deps
156	
157	      - name: Start Next.js server (background)
158	        run: |
159	          yarn start &
160	          echo $! > .next-server.pid
161	          echo "Started Next.js server with PID $(cat .next-server.pid)"
162	        env:
163	          NODE_ENV: production
164	          PORT: 3000
165	          E2E_TEST_MODE: "1"
166	          NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_TEST_MODE: "1"
167	          HMAC_SECRET: ${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
168	          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
169	          NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://www.esdeveniments.cat
170	          REVALIDATE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.REVALIDATE_SECRET }}
171	
172	      - name: Wait for server to be ready
173	        run: npx wait-on http://localhost:3000 --timeout 60000
174	
175	      - name: Sanity check robots.txt
176	        run: |
177	          set -euo pipefail
178	          robots="$(curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/robots.txt)"
179	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "allow: /" > /dev/null
180	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "disallow: /_next/" > /dev/null
181	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "disallow: /api/" > /dev/null
182	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "user-agent: gptbot" > /dev/null
183	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "sitemap: https://www.esdeveniments.cat/server-static-sitemap.xml" > /dev/null
184	          echo "robots.txt looks correct"
185	
186	      - name: Run E2E tests
187	        run: yarn test:e2e -c playwright.remote.config.ts --workers=2
188	        env:
189	          CI: true
190	          PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000
191	
192	      - name: Stop Next.js server
193	        if: always()
194	        run: |
195	          if [ -f .next-server.pid ]; then
196	            kill $(cat .next-server.pid) || true
197	            rm .next-server.pid
198	          fi
199	          pkill -f "yarn start" || true
200	
201	      - name: Upload Playwright report (on failure)
202	        if: failure()
203	        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
204	        with:
205	          name: playwright-report-deploy
206	          path: playwright-report/
207	          retention-days: 7
208	          if-no-files-found: ignore
209	
210	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
211	  # Build the production image on a GitHub runner and push it to GHCR.
212	  # The heavy Next.js build used to run on the shared Coolify host and
213	  # starved prod of CPU during deploys; building here keeps it off-box.
214	  # Coolify then deploys this prebuilt image (Docker Image source).
215	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
216	  build-and-push:
217	    name: Build & push image
218	    needs: [quality, unit-tests, e2e-tests]
219	    # Build only when the CI jobs that ran passed (mirrors the deploy gate).
220	    if: >-
221	      always() &&
222	      !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.skip_ci) &&
223	      (needs.quality.result == 'success' || needs.quality.result == 'skipped') &&
224	      (needs.unit-tests.result == 'success' || needs.unit-tests.result == 'skipped') &&
225	      (needs.e2e-tests.result == 'success' || needs.e2e-tests.result == 'skipped')
226	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
227	    timeout-minutes: 30
228	    permissions:
229	      contents: read
230	      packages: write
231	    # Environment-scoped secrets let the develop (staging) build inline its own
232	    # NEXT_PUBLIC_* values, overriding the repo-level prod defaults.
233	    environment:
234	      name: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'production' || 'staging' }}
235	    steps:
236	      - name: Checkout repository
237	        uses: actions/checkout@v7
238	
239	      - name: Compute lowercase image name
240	        id: meta
241	        run: echo "image=ghcr.io/$(echo '${{ github.repository }}' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
242	
243	      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
244	        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
245	
246	      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
247	        uses: docker/login-action@v3
248	        with:
249	          registry: ghcr.io
250	          username: ${{ github.actor }}
251	          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
252	
253	      - name: Build and push image
254	        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
255	        with:
256	          context: .
257	          push: true
258	          tags: |
259	            ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}:${{ github.ref_name }}
260	            ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}:sha-${{ github.sha }}
261	          cache-from: type=gha
262	          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
263	          # NEXT_PUBLIC_* are inlined into the client bundle (public by design).
264	          # HMAC_SECRET / SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN are used only in the builder stage and
265	          # do not persist in the final runner image (multi-stage Dockerfile).
266	          build-args: |
267	            BUILD_VERSION=${{ github.sha }}
268	            NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
269	            NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL }}
270	            NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN }}
271	            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS }}
272	            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS }}
273	            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION }}
274	            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS }}
275	            NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY }}
276	            NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI }}
277	            NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY }}
278	            HMAC_SECRET=${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
279	            SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN=${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
280	            SENTRY_ORG=${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
281	            SENTRY_PROJECT=${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
282	
283	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
284	  # Deploy to Coolify (waits for whichever CI jobs actually ran)
285	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
286	  deploy:
287	    name: Deploy to Coolify
288	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
289	    needs: [quality, unit-tests, e2e-tests, build-and-push]
290	    # Run deploy if all non-skipped jobs succeeded.
291	    # `always()` lets us proceed when skipped jobs report as skipped (not failed).
292	    if: >-
293	      always() &&
294	      (needs.quality.result == 'success' || needs.quality.result == 'skipped') &&
295	      (needs.unit-tests.result == 'success' || needs.unit-tests.result == 'skipped') &&
296	      (needs.e2e-tests.result == 'success' || needs.e2e-tests.result == 'skipped') &&
297	      (needs.build-and-push.result == 'success' || needs.build-and-push.result == 'skipped')
298	    # 20 min = 15 min MAX_WAIT for Coolify build (prod Next.js + Docker rebuilds
299	    # run ~12 min) + ~5 min for webhook trigger, smoke tests, and runner overhead.
300	    timeout-minutes: 20
301	    # GitHub Environment enables protection rules, required reviewers, and environment-specific secrets
302	    environment:
303	      name: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'production' || 'staging' }}
304	      url: ${{ env.DEPLOY_URL }}
305	
306	    steps:
307	      - name: Deployment mode summary
308	        run: |
309	          echo "## Deployment Mode" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
310	          echo "| Check | Status |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
311	          echo "|-------|--------|" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
312	          echo "| Quality (lint+typecheck) | ${{ needs.quality.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
313	          echo "| Unit tests | ${{ needs.unit-tests.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
314	          echo "| E2E tests | ${{ needs.e2e-tests.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
315	          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
316	          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
317	            echo "**Trigger:** Manual dispatch" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
318	            echo "- skip_e2e: ${{ inputs.skip_e2e }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
319	            echo "- skip_tests: ${{ inputs.skip_tests }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
320	            echo "- skip_ci: ${{ inputs.skip_ci }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
321	          else
322	            echo "**Trigger:** Push to ${{ github.ref_name }} ($([ '${{ github.ref_name }}' = 'main' ] && echo 'full CI' || echo 'lint+typecheck+unit'))" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
323	          fi
324	
325	      # Coolify's app config points at the floating `:main` registry tag. A
326	      # health-check-triggered container restart recreates the container
327	      # from whatever image is locally cached under that tag WITHOUT going
328	      # through this deploy pipeline — so a restart can silently resurrect
329	      # stale code hours after a correct deploy, with no CI run, webhook, or
330	      # API call to show for it. This happened on 2026-07-31: the RSC
331	      # cache-poisoning fix (0cdf6f8e) deployed correctly at 14:34 UTC, then
332	      # a restart at 19:01 UTC reverted it. Pinning to the immutable
333	      # `sha-<commit>` tag (already pushed by build-and-push, above) before
334	      # every deploy removes the floating tag a restart could resurrect.
335	      # See docs/incidents/2026-04-04-cloudflare-rsc-cache-poisoning.md.
336	      - name: Pin Coolify to this commit's immutable image tag
337	        # skip_ci (emergency deploy) also skips build-and-push above, so no
338	        # sha-<commit> image exists to pin to — leave whatever tag is already
339	        # configured alone and let the webhook redeploy it as-is.
340	        if: needs.build-and-push.result == 'success'
341	        env:
342	          COOLIFY_TOKEN: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN || secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN_STAGING }}
343	          COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL || secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL_STAGING }}
344	        run: |
345	          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" ]; then
346	            echo "::error::COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL secret is required"
347	            exit 1
348	          fi
349	
350	          # The webhook URL is Coolify's own `POST /api/v1/deploy?uuid=...`
351	          # trigger — reuse its host and uuid instead of adding new secrets.
352	          COOLIFY_API_BASE=$(echo "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" | grep -oP '^https?://[^/]+')
353	          COOLIFY_APP_UUID=$(echo "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" | grep -oP '(?<=[?&]uuid=)[^&]+')
354	
355	          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_API_BASE" ] || [ -z "$COOLIFY_APP_UUID" ]; then
356	            echo "::error::Could not parse host/uuid out of COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL — expected .../api/v1/deploy?uuid=<uuid>. Refusing to deploy on the floating tag; fix the URL or this parsing."
357	            exit 1
358	          fi
359	
360	          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/coolify-patch-response.json -w "%{http_code}" \
361	            -X PATCH "${COOLIFY_API_BASE}/api/v1/applications/${COOLIFY_APP_UUID}" \
362	            -H "Authorization: Bearer $COOLIFY_TOKEN" \
363	            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
364	            --data "{\"docker_registry_image_tag\": \"sha-${{ github.sha }}\"}" \
365	            --max-time 15) || HTTP_CODE="000"
366	
367	          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -lt 200 ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 300 ]; then
368	            echo "::error::Failed to pin docker_registry_image_tag (HTTP $HTTP_CODE) — aborting rather than deploying on the floating :main tag"
369	            cat /tmp/coolify-patch-response.json 2>/dev/null || true
370	            exit 1
371	          fi
372	
373	          echo "Pinned esdeveniments-production to sha-${{ github.sha }}"
374	
375	      - name: Trigger Coolify deployment
376	        env:
377	          COOLIFY_TOKEN: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN || secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN_STAGING }}
378	          COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL || secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL_STAGING }}
379	        run: |
380	          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" ]; then
381	            echo "::error::COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL secret is required"
382	            exit 1
383	          fi
384	
385	          # Trigger deployment via Coolify webhook with retries
386	          MAX_RETRIES=3
387	          RETRY_DELAY=5
388	          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_RETRIES); do
389	            HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/coolify-response.json -w "%{http_code}" \
390	              -X POST "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" \
391	              -H "Authorization: Bearer $COOLIFY_TOKEN" \
392	              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
393	              --max-time 30) || HTTP_CODE="000"
394	
395	            echo "Attempt $attempt: Coolify API response HTTP $HTTP_CODE"
396	
397	            if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 200 ] && [ "$HTTP_CODE" -lt 300 ]; then
398	              echo "Deployment triggered successfully"
399	              exit 0
400	            fi
401	
402	            if [ "$attempt" -lt "$MAX_RETRIES" ]; then
403	              echo "Retrying in ${RETRY_DELAY}s..."
404	              sleep $RETRY_DELAY
405	              RETRY_DELAY=$((RETRY_DELAY * 2))
406	            fi
407	          done
408	
409	          echo "::error::Coolify deployment trigger failed after $MAX_RETRIES attempts (last HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
410	          cat /tmp/coolify-response.json 2>/dev/null || true
411	          exit 1
412	
413	      - name: Wait for Coolify deployment to complete
414	        env:
415	          REVALIDATE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.REVALIDATE_SECRET }}
416	          EXPECTED_VERSION: ${{ github.sha }}
417	          SITE_URL: ${{ env.DEPLOY_URL }}
418	        run: |
419	          echo "Waiting for Coolify deployment..."
420	          # Poll health endpoint until the new container is live. Requires
421	          # BUILD_VERSION=$SOURCE_COMMIT to be set as a build variable in the
422	          # Coolify dashboard → Application → Environment so /api/health
423	          # exposes the running commit SHA.
424	          #
425	          # Prod Next.js + Docker rebuilds on Coolify run ~12 minutes. Too-short
426	          # a MAX_WAIT fails the step (and skips the CDN purge + smoke tests)
427	          # even though the deploy then succeeds — a false negative.
428	          MAX_WAIT=900  # 15 minutes — covers the ~12 min full rebuild with margin
429	          INTERVAL=10
430	          ELAPSED=0
431	          DEPLOY_CONFIRMED=0
432	
433	          # Initial wait for Coolify to start building
434	          sleep 15
435	          ELAPSED=15
436	
437	          # Record the current live version before deployment
438	          PRE_DEPLOY_VERSION=$(curl -s --max-time 5 \
439	            "${SITE_URL}/api/health?secret=${REVALIDATE_SECRET}" \
440	            | grep -o '"buildVersion":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4) || PRE_DEPLOY_VERSION=""
441	
442	          while [ $ELAPSED -lt $MAX_WAIT ]; do
443	            RESPONSE=$(curl -s --max-time 5 \
444	              "${SITE_URL}/api/health?secret=${REVALIDATE_SECRET}") || RESPONSE=""
445	
446	            LIVE_VERSION=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"buildVersion":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4) || LIVE_VERSION=""
447	            HTTP_OK=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"status":"healthy"') || HTTP_OK=""
448	
449	            # Only accept exact version match. A "just became non-pre-deploy
450	            # and non-expected" heuristic looks like it means "superseded by a
451	            # later push", but it also fires when a PRIOR failed/slow build
452	            # retroactively propagates mid-poll — which masks real failures of
453	            # OUR commit. Require exact SHA match; if concurrent pushes caused
454	            # an earlier workflow to never see its exact SHA, that workflow
455	            # will fail, which is recoverable. False successes are not.
456	            if [ "$LIVE_VERSION" = "$EXPECTED_VERSION" ]; then
457	              echo "New revision ${EXPECTED_VERSION:0:7} is live after ${ELAPSED}s"
458	              DEPLOY_CONFIRMED=1
459	              break
460	            fi
461	
462	            echo "Waiting... live=${LIVE_VERSION:-unknown} (${ELAPSED}s elapsed)"
463	            sleep $INTERVAL
464	            ELAPSED=$((ELAPSED + INTERVAL))
465	          done
466	
467	          # Post-loop: if we never confirmed a deploy, fail with a specific
468	          # diagnosis. Previous behavior exited green after 60s via a "last
469	          # resort" branch that incorrectly conflated "build still running"
470	          # with "BUILD_VERSION not configured", hiding real deploy failures.
471	          if [ "$DEPLOY_CONFIRMED" -ne 1 ]; then
472	            if [ -z "$HTTP_OK" ]; then
473	              echo "::error::Health endpoint unresponsive within ${MAX_WAIT}s"
474	            elif [ -z "$LIVE_VERSION" ] || [ "$LIVE_VERSION" = "unknown" ]; then
475	              echo "::error::Health endpoint is up but did not expose a buildVersion. Check that BUILD_VERSION=\$SOURCE_COMMIT is set as a build variable in Coolify → Application → Environment."
476	            elif [ "$LIVE_VERSION" = "$PRE_DEPLOY_VERSION" ]; then
477	              echo "::error::Container did NOT swap within ${MAX_WAIT}s. live=${LIVE_VERSION:0:7} expected=${EXPECTED_VERSION:0:7}. Coolify build may still be running or may have failed — check the Coolify dashboard. If builds legitimately take longer, bump MAX_WAIT in this workflow."
478	            else
479	              echo "::error::Container swapped but serving the wrong commit within ${MAX_WAIT}s. live=${LIVE_VERSION:0:7} expected=${EXPECTED_VERSION:0:7}. Possible causes: (1) a rapid subsequent push caused Coolify to process webhooks out of order; (2) a prior failed build retried mid-poll. Re-run the workflow or push again."
480	            fi
481	            exit 1
482	          fi
483	
484	      - name: Purge Cloudflare CDN cache
485	        if: github.ref_name == 'main'
486	        env:
487	          CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID }}
488	          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
489	        run: |
490	          if [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID" ] || [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" ]; then
491	            echo "::warning::CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID or CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN not set — skipping CDN purge"
492	            exit 0
493	          fi
494	
495	          echo "Purging Cloudflare cache to prevent stale chunk references..."
496	          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/cf-purge.json -w "%{http_code}" \
497	            -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID}/purge_cache" \
498	            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}" \
499	            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
500	            --data '{"purge_everything":true}' \
501	            --max-time 10) || HTTP_CODE="000"
502	
503	          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
504	            echo "Cloudflare cache purged successfully"
505	          else
506	            echo "::warning::Cloudflare purge returned HTTP $HTTP_CODE (non-fatal)"
507	            cat /tmp/cf-purge.json 2>/dev/null || true
508	          fi
509	
510	      - name: Post-deploy smoke tests
511	        env:
512	          REVALIDATE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.REVALIDATE_SECRET }}
513	          IS_PRODUCTION_DEPLOY: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' }}
514	          SITE_URL: ${{ env.DEPLOY_URL }}
515	        run: |
516	          FAILED=0
517	
518	          # Critical smoke tests — these MUST pass
519	          echo "Running critical smoke tests..."
520	
521	          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 10 "${SITE_URL}/") || HTTP_CODE="000"
522	          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
523	            echo "Homepage: OK"
524	          else
525	            echo "::error::Homepage returned HTTP $HTTP_CODE"
526	            FAILED=1
527	          fi
528	
529	          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 10 "${SITE_URL}/barcelona") || HTTP_CODE="000"
530	          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
531	            echo "Barcelona page: OK"
532	          else
533	            echo "::error::Barcelona page returned HTTP $HTTP_CODE"
534	            FAILED=1
535	          fi
536	
537	          ROBOTS_TXT=$(curl -sf --max-time 5 "${SITE_URL}/robots.txt") || ROBOTS_TXT=""
538	          if [ -z "$ROBOTS_TXT" ]; then
539	            echo "::error::robots.txt could not be fetched"
540	            FAILED=1
541	          elif [ "$IS_PRODUCTION_DEPLOY" = "true" ]; then
542	            echo "$ROBOTS_TXT" | grep -q "Sitemap:" && echo "robots.txt: OK" || { echo "::error::production robots.txt missing Sitemap directive"; FAILED=1; }
543	          else
544	            echo "$ROBOTS_TXT" | grep -q "Disallow: /" && echo "robots.txt: OK (staging disallows crawlers)" || { echo "::error::staging robots.txt does not disallow crawlers"; FAILED=1; }
545	          fi
546	
547	          # Health check with details
548	          echo ""
549	          echo "Checking deployment health..."
550	          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/health.json -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 5 "${SITE_URL}/api/health?secret=${REVALIDATE_SECRET}") || HTTP_CODE="000"
551	          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ] && [ -f /tmp/health.json ]; then
552	            echo "Health endpoint: OK"
553	            CACHE=$(jq -r '.cache.strategy // "unknown"' /tmp/health.json)
554	            echo "Cache strategy: $CACHE"
555	            if [ "$CACHE" != "redis" ]; then
556	              echo "::warning::Redis cache not connected (strategy: $CACHE)"
557	            fi
558	          else
559	            echo "::error::Health endpoint returned HTTP $HTTP_CODE"
560	            FAILED=1
561	          fi
562	
563	          # Summary
564	          echo ""
565	          echo "## Post-Deploy Smoke Tests" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
566	          if [ $FAILED -eq 0 ]; then
567	            echo "All critical smoke tests passed." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
568	          else
569	            echo "**Some smoke tests failed — check logs above.**" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
570	            echo "::error::Post-deploy smoke tests failed — deployment may be broken"
571	            exit 1
572	          fi
573	
574	      - name: Deployment summary
575	        if: success()
576	        run: |
577	          echo "## Deployment Result" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
578	          echo "Deployment completed successfully!" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
579	          echo "- **Site:** ${{ env.DEPLOY_URL }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
580	          echo "- **Environment:** ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'production' || 'staging' }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
581	          echo "- **Commit:** ${{ github.sha }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
582	          echo "- **Triggered by:** ${{ github.actor }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
583

file.content:
name: Deploy to Coolify

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths-ignore:
      - "**/*.md"
      - "docs/**"
      - ".claude/**"
      - ".github/skills/**"
      - ".vscode/**"
      - ".cursor/**"
      - "LICENSE"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      skip_e2e:
        description: "Skip E2E tests (faster deploy)"
        type: boolean
        default: false
      skip_tests:
        description: "Skip ALL tests (lint + typecheck still run)"
        type: boolean
        default: false
      skip_ci:
        description: "Skip entire CI — deploy immediately (emergency only)"
        type: boolean
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: deploy-coolify-${{ github.ref }}
  # Cancel superseded deploys. Coolify has a known stuck-build bug class
  # (coollabsio/coolify #5850, #6414, #6579) where overlapping Next.js
  # builds on the app server can wedge one build "In Progress" forever,
  # which in turn blocks Coolify's automatic Docker cleanup from running
  # and fills the disk. Cancelling in-flight deploys on a newer push is
  # safer than queueing them.
  cancel-in-progress: true

# Explicit least-privilege permissions (security best practice)
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

env:
  NODE_VERSION: "22"
  IS_PRODUCTION: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' }}
  DEPLOY_URL: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'https://www.esdeveniments.cat' || 'https://staging.esdeveniments.cat' }}

jobs:
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Quality gate: lint + typecheck (always runs unless skip_ci)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  quality:
    name: Lint & Typecheck
    if: ${{ !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.skip_ci) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: yarn

      - name: Enable Corepack (Yarn 4)
        run: corepack enable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --immutable

      - name: Lint
        run: yarn lint

      - name: Type check
        run: yarn typecheck

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Unit tests (skipped when skip_tests or skip_ci)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  unit-tests:
    name: Unit tests
    if: >-
      !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
        (inputs.skip_tests || inputs.skip_ci))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: yarn

      - name: Enable Corepack (Yarn 4)
        run: corepack enable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --immutable

      - name: Run unit tests
        env:
          CI: true
        run: yarn test

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build + E2E tests (skipped when skip_e2e, skip_tests, or skip_ci)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  e2e-tests:
    name: Build & E2E tests
    if: >-
      github.ref_name == 'main' &&
      !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
        (inputs.skip_e2e || inputs.skip_tests || inputs.skip_ci))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: yarn

      - name: Enable Corepack (Yarn 4)
        run: corepack enable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --immutable

      - name: Generate service worker and robots.txt (prebuild)
        env:
          BUILD_VERSION: ${{ github.sha }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://www.esdeveniments.cat
        run: yarn prebuild

      - name: Build Next.js application
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
          HMAC_SECRET: ${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://www.esdeveniments.cat
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
        run: yarn build

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: npx playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: Start Next.js server (background)
        run: |
          yarn start &
          echo $! > .next-server.pid
          echo "Started Next.js server with PID $(cat .next-server.pid)"
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
          PORT: 3000
          E2E_TEST_MODE: "1"
          NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_TEST_MODE: "1"
          HMAC_SECRET: ${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://www.esdeveniments.cat
          REVALIDATE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.REVALIDATE_SECRET }}

      - name: Wait for server to be ready
        run: npx wait-on http://localhost:3000 --timeout 60000

      - name: Sanity check robots.txt
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          robots="$(curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/robots.txt)"
          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "allow: /" > /dev/null
          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "disallow: /_next/" > /dev/null
          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "disallow: /api/" > /dev/null
          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "user-agent: gptbot" > /dev/null
          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "sitemap: https://www.esdeveniments.cat/server-static-sitemap.xml" > /dev/null
          echo "robots.txt looks correct"

      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: yarn test:e2e -c playwright.remote.config.ts --workers=2
        env:
          CI: true
          PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000

      - name: Stop Next.js server
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f .next-server.pid ]; then
            kill $(cat .next-server.pid) || true
            rm .next-server.pid
          fi
          pkill -f "yarn start" || true

      - name: Upload Playwright report (on failure)
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: playwright-report-deploy
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build the production image on a GitHub runner and push it to GHCR.
  # The heavy Next.js build used to run on the shared Coolify host and
  # starved prod of CPU during deploys; building here keeps it off-box.
  # Coolify then deploys this prebuilt image (Docker Image source).
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  build-and-push:
    name: Build & push image
    needs: [quality, unit-tests, e2e-tests]
    # Build only when the CI jobs that ran passed (mirrors the deploy gate).
    if: >-
      always() &&
      !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.skip_ci) &&
      (needs.quality.result == 'success' || needs.quality.result == 'skipped') &&
      (needs.unit-tests.result == 'success' || needs.unit-tests.result == 'skipped') &&
      (needs.e2e-tests.result == 'success' || needs.e2e-tests.result == 'skipped')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    # Environment-scoped secrets let the develop (staging) build inline its own
    # NEXT_PUBLIC_* values, overriding the repo-level prod defaults.
    environment:
      name: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'production' || 'staging' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Compute lowercase image name
        id: meta
        run: echo "image=ghcr.io/$(echo '${{ github.repository }}' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}:${{ github.ref_name }}
            ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}:sha-${{ github.sha }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          # NEXT_PUBLIC_* are inlined into the client bundle (public by design).
          # HMAC_SECRET / SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN are used only in the builder stage and
          # do not persist in the final runner image (multi-stage Dockerfile).
          build-args: |
            BUILD_VERSION=${{ github.sha }}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL }}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN }}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS }}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS }}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION }}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS }}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY }}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI }}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY }}
            HMAC_SECRET=${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
            SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN=${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
            SENTRY_ORG=${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
            SENTRY_PROJECT=${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Deploy to Coolify (waits for whichever CI jobs actually ran)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  deploy:
    name: Deploy to Coolify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [quality, unit-tests, e2e-tests, build-and-push]
    # Run deploy if all non-skipped jobs succeeded.
    # `always()` lets us proceed when skipped jobs report as skipped (not failed).
    if: >-
      always() &&
      (needs.quality.result == 'success' || needs.quality.result == 'skipped') &&
      (needs.unit-tests.result == 'success' || needs.unit-tests.result == 'skipped') &&
      (needs.e2e-tests.result == 'success' || needs.e2e-tests.result == 'skipped') &&
      (needs.build-and-push.result == 'success' || needs.build-and-push.result == 'skipped')
    # 20 min = 15 min MAX_WAIT for Coolify build (prod Next.js + Docker rebuilds
    # run ~12 min) + ~5 min for webhook trigger, smoke tests, and runner overhead.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    # GitHub Environment enables protection rules, required reviewers, and environment-specific secrets
    environment:
      name: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'production' || 'staging' }}
      url: ${{ env.DEPLOY_URL }}

    steps:
      - name: Deployment mode summary
        run: |
          echo "## Deployment Mode" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Check | Status |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "|-------|--------|" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Quality (lint+typecheck) | ${{ needs.quality.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Unit tests | ${{ needs.unit-tests.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| E2E tests | ${{ needs.e2e-tests.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            echo "**Trigger:** Manual dispatch" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo "- skip_e2e: ${{ inputs.skip_e2e }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo "- skip_tests: ${{ inputs.skip_tests }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo "- skip_ci: ${{ inputs.skip_ci }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          else
            echo "**Trigger:** Push to ${{ github.ref_name }} ($([ '${{ github.ref_name }}' = 'main' ] && echo 'full CI' || echo 'lint+typecheck+unit'))" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          fi

      # Coolify's app config points at the floating `:main` registry tag. A
      # health-check-triggered container restart recreates the container
      # from whatever image is locally cached under that tag WITHOUT going
      # through this deploy pipeline — so a restart can silently resurrect
      # stale code hours after a correct deploy, with no CI run, webhook, or
      # API call to show for it. This happened on 2026-07-31: the RSC
      # cache-poisoning fix (0cdf6f8e) deployed correctly at 14:34 UTC, then
      # a restart at 19:01 UTC reverted it. Pinning to the immutable
      # `sha-<commit>` tag (already pushed by build-and-push, above) before
      # every deploy removes the floating tag a restart could resurrect.
      # See docs/incidents/2026-04-04-cloudflare-rsc-cache-poisoning.md.
      - name: Pin Coolify to this commit's immutable image tag
        # skip_ci (emergency deploy) also skips build-and-push above, so no
        # sha-<commit> image exists to pin to — leave whatever tag is already
        # configured alone and let the webhook redeploy it as-is.
        if: needs.build-and-push.result == 'success'
        env:
          COOLIFY_TOKEN: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN || secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN_STAGING }}
          COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL || secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL_STAGING }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" ]; then
            echo "::error::COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL secret is required"
            exit 1
          fi

          # The webhook URL is Coolify's own `POST /api/v1/deploy?uuid=...`
          # trigger — reuse its host and uuid instead of adding new secrets.
          COOLIFY_API_BASE=$(echo "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" | grep -oP '^https?://[^/]+')
          COOLIFY_APP_UUID=$(echo "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" | grep -oP '(?<=[?&]uuid=)[^&]+')

          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_API_BASE" ] || [ -z "$COOLIFY_APP_UUID" ]; then
            echo "::error::Could not parse host/uuid out of COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL — expected .../api/v1/deploy?uuid=<uuid>. Refusing to deploy on the floating tag; fix the URL or this parsing."
            exit 1
          fi

          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/coolify-patch-response.json -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X PATCH "${COOLIFY_API_BASE}/api/v1/applications/${COOLIFY_APP_UUID}" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $COOLIFY_TOKEN" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            --data "{\"docker_registry_image_tag\": \"sha-${{ github.sha }}\"}" \
            --max-time 15) || HTTP_CODE="000"

          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -lt 200 ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 300 ]; then
            echo "::error::Failed to pin docker_registry_image_tag (HTTP $HTTP_CODE) — aborting rather than deploying on the floating :main tag"
            cat /tmp/coolify-patch-response.json 2>/dev/null || true
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Pinned esdeveniments-production to sha-${{ github.sha }}"

      - name: Trigger Coolify deployment
        env:
          COOLIFY_TOKEN: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN || secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN_STAGING }}
          COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL || secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL_STAGING }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" ]; then
            echo "::error::COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL secret is required"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Trigger deployment via Coolify webhook with retries
          MAX_RETRIES=3
          RETRY_DELAY=5
          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_RETRIES); do
            HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/coolify-response.json -w "%{http_code}" \
              -X POST "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $COOLIFY_TOKEN" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              --max-time 30) || HTTP_CODE="000"

            echo "Attempt $attempt: Coolify API response HTTP $HTTP_CODE"

            if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 200 ] && [ "$HTTP_CODE" -lt 300 ]; then
              echo "Deployment triggered successfully"
              exit 0
            fi

            if [ "$attempt" -lt "$MAX_RETRIES" ]; then
              echo "Retrying in ${RETRY_DELAY}s..."
              sleep $RETRY_DELAY
              RETRY_DELAY=$((RETRY_DELAY * 2))
            fi
          done

          echo "::error::Coolify deployment trigger failed after $MAX_RETRIES attempts (last HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
          cat /tmp/coolify-response.json 2>/dev/null || true
          exit 1

      - name: Wait for Coolify deployment to complete
        env:
          REVALIDATE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.REVALIDATE_SECRET }}
          EXPECTED_VERSION: ${{ github.sha }}
          SITE_URL: ${{ env.DEPLOY_URL }}
        run: |
          echo "Waiting for Coolify deployment..."
          # Poll health endpoint until the new container is live. Requires
          # BUILD_VERSION=$SOURCE_COMMIT to be set as a build variable in the
          # Coolify dashboard → Application → Environment so /api/health
          # exposes the running commit SHA.
          #
          # Prod Next.js + Docker rebuilds on Coolify run ~12 minutes. Too-short
          # a MAX_WAIT fails the step (and skips the CDN purge + smoke tests)
          # even though the deploy then succeeds — a false negative.
          MAX_WAIT=900  # 15 minutes — covers the ~12 min full rebuild with margin
          INTERVAL=10
          ELAPSED=0
          DEPLOY_CONFIRMED=0

          # Initial wait for Coolify to start building
          sleep 15
          ELAPSED=15

          # Record the current live version before deployment
          PRE_DEPLOY_VERSION=$(curl -s --max-time 5 \
            "${SITE_URL}/api/health?secret=${REVALIDATE_SECRET}" \
            | grep -o '"buildVersion":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4) || PRE_DEPLOY_VERSION=""

          while [ $ELAPSED -lt $MAX_WAIT ]; do
            RESPONSE=$(curl -s --max-time 5 \
              "${SITE_URL}/api/health?secret=${REVALIDATE_SECRET}") || RESPONSE=""

            LIVE_VERSION=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"buildVersion":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4) || LIVE_VERSION=""
            HTTP_OK=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"status":"healthy"') || HTTP_OK=""

            # Only accept exact version match. A "just became non-pre-deploy
            # and non-expected" heuristic looks like it means "superseded by a
            # later push", but it also fires when a PRIOR failed/slow build
            # retroactively propagates mid-poll — which masks real failures of
            # OUR commit. Require exact SHA match; if concurrent pushes caused
            # an earlier workflow to never see its exact SHA, that workflow
            # will fail, which is recoverable. False successes are not.
            if [ "$LIVE_VERSION" = "$EXPECTED_VERSION" ]; then
              echo "New revision ${EXPECTED_VERSION:0:7} is live after ${ELAPSED}s"
              DEPLOY_CONFIRMED=1
              break
            fi

            echo "Waiting... live=${LIVE_VERSION:-unknown} (${ELAPSED}s elapsed)"
            sleep $INTERVAL
            ELAPSED=$((ELAPSED + INTERVAL))
          done

          # Post-loop: if we never confirmed a deploy, fail with a specific
          # diagnosis. Previous behavior exited green after 60s via a "last
          # resort" branch that incorrectly conflated "build still running"
          # with "BUILD_VERSION not configured", hiding real deploy failures.
          if [ "$DEPLOY_CONFIRMED" -ne 1 ]; then
            if [ -z "$HTTP_OK" ]; then
              echo "::error::Health endpoint unresponsive within ${MAX_WAIT}s"
            elif [ -z "$LIVE_VERSION" ] || [ "$LIVE_VERSION" = "unknown" ]; then
              echo "::error::Health endpoint is up but did not expose a buildVersion. Check that BUILD_VERSION=\$SOURCE_COMMIT is set as a build variable in Coolify → Application → Environment."
            elif [ "$LIVE_VERSION" = "$PRE_DEPLOY_VERSION" ]; then
              echo "::error::Container did NOT swap within ${MAX_WAIT}s. live=${LIVE_VERSION:0:7} expected=${EXPECTED_VERSION:0:7}. Coolify build may still be running or may have failed — check the Coolify dashboard. If builds legitimately take longer, bump MAX_WAIT in this workflow."
            else
              echo "::error::Container swapped but serving the wrong commit within ${MAX_WAIT}s. live=${LIVE_VERSION:0:7} expected=${EXPECTED_VERSION:0:7}. Possible causes: (1) a rapid subsequent push caused Coolify to process webhooks out of order; (2) a prior failed build retried mid-poll. Re-run the workflow or push again."
            fi
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Purge Cloudflare CDN cache
        if: github.ref_name == 'main'
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID }}
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID" ] || [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "::warning::CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID or CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN not set — skipping CDN purge"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Purging Cloudflare cache to prevent stale chunk references..."
          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/cf-purge.json -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID}/purge_cache" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            --data '{"purge_everything":true}' \
            --max-time 10) || HTTP_CODE="000"

          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
            echo "Cloudflare cache purged successfully"
          else
            echo "::warning::Cloudflare purge returned HTTP $HTTP_CODE (non-fatal)"
            cat /tmp/cf-purge.json 2>/dev/null || true
          fi

      - name: Post-deploy smoke tests
        env:
          REVALIDATE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.REVALIDATE_SECRET }}
          IS_PRODUCTION_DEPLOY: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' }}
          SITE_URL: ${{ env.DEPLOY_URL }}
        run: |
          FAILED=0

          # Critical smoke tests — these MUST pass
          echo "Running critical smoke tests..."

          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 10 "${SITE_URL}/") || HTTP_CODE="000"
          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
            echo "Homepage: OK"
          else
            echo "::error::Homepage returned HTTP $HTTP_CODE"
            FAILED=1
          fi

          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 10 "${SITE_URL}/barcelona") || HTTP_CODE="000"
          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
            echo "Barcelona page: OK"
          else
            echo "::error::Barcelona page returned HTTP $HTTP_CODE"
            FAILED=1
          fi

          ROBOTS_TXT=$(curl -sf --max-time 5 "${SITE_URL}/robots.txt") || ROBOTS_TXT=""
          if [ -z "$ROBOTS_TXT" ]; then
            echo "::error::robots.txt could not be fetched"
            FAILED=1
          elif [ "$IS_PRODUCTION_DEPLOY" = "true" ]; then
            echo "$ROBOTS_TXT" | grep -q "Sitemap:" && echo "robots.txt: OK" || { echo "::error::production robots.txt missing Sitemap directive"; FAILED=1; }
          else
            echo "$ROBOTS_TXT" | grep -q "Disallow: /" && echo "robots.txt: OK (staging disallows crawlers)" || { echo "::error::staging robots.txt does not disallow crawlers"; FAILED=1; }
          fi

          # Health check with details
          echo ""
          echo "Checking deployment health..."
          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/health.json -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 5 "${SITE_URL}/api/health?secret=${REVALIDATE_SECRET}") || HTTP_CODE="000"
          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ] && [ -f /tmp/health.json ]; then
            echo "Health endpoint: OK"
            CACHE=$(jq -r '.cache.strategy // "unknown"' /tmp/health.json)
            echo "Cache strategy: $CACHE"
            if [ "$CACHE" != "redis" ]; then
              echo "::warning::Redis cache not connected (strategy: $CACHE)"
            fi
          else
            echo "::error::Health endpoint returned HTTP $HTTP_CODE"
            FAILED=1
          fi

          # Summary
          echo ""
          echo "## Post-Deploy Smoke Tests" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          if [ $FAILED -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "All critical smoke tests passed." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          else
            echo "**Some smoke tests failed — check logs above.**" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo "::error::Post-deploy smoke tests failed — deployment may be broken"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Deployment summary
        if: success()
        run: |
          echo "## Deployment Result" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "Deployment completed successfully!" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Site:** ${{ env.DEPLOY_URL }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Environment:** ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'production' || 'staging' }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Commit:** ${{ github.sha }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Triggered by:** ${{ github.actor }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

content.text:
Looking at this change, I need to trace what it actually alters and whether it introduces a security regression.

**What the change does:** Adds `if: needs.build-and-push.result == 'success'` to the "Pin Coolify to this commit's immutable image tag" step. Previously the step ran unconditionally when the deploy job ran; now it's skipped when `build-and-push` didn't succeed (i.e., was skipped due to `skip_ci`).

**Security-relevant context I verified in the file:**

1. The pin step exists specifically to prevent a documented cache-poisoning incident (2026-07-31 RSC): Coolify's floating `:main` tag can silently resurrect stale code on container restart.

2. Deploy job's `if:` condition (lines 292-297) allows `build-and-push.result == 'skipped'` to proceed. `build-and-push` is only skipped in one case: `workflow_dispatch` with `skip_ci=true` (line 222).

3. The "Trigger Coolify deployment" step (line 375) is a sibling that still runs unconditionally, firing the webhook regardless of whether the pin ran.

4. The "Wait for Coolify deployment" step (line 442-465) requires exact SHA match (`LIVE_VERSION = EXPECTED_VERSION = github.sha`).

**Sibling-path gate parity analysis:**
- Pin step: now gated on `build-and-push.result == 'success'`
- Trigger webhook step: no equivalent gate — still fires

In `skip_ci` mode, the webhook triggers a redeploy of whatever Coolify currently has pinned (per the comment: "let the webhook redeploy it as-is"). This is intentional. The wait step will then fail unless the currently-pinned image already matches `github.sha`, so operationally the "emergency deploy" is safe-fails rather than deploys wrong code.

**Rollback / stale-code attack analysis:**
- Attacker with `workflow_dispatch` permission running `skip_ci`: pin skipped → webhook redeploys the CURRENTLY-PINNED image. This does not enable rolling back to an arbitrary old vulnerable commit; it only re-triggers whatever Coolify currently has configured, which was set by a prior successful (pin-gated) deploy.
- Before this change: `skip_ci` would PATCH Coolify to `sha-<nonexistent>` and break the deploy. After: it leaves the pin alone. No net attack surface added.

**RSC cache-poisoning risk:**
- Normal deploys: pin still runs → protection unchanged.
- `skip_ci` deploys: pin is skipped, but no NEW floating-tag state is introduced. If Coolify was already on a pinned `sha-*` (the normal state after any successful deploy), it stays that way. If it was somehow on `:main`, that pre-existing risk is unchanged, not worsened.

**CI/CD trust:** `workflow_dispatch` inputs are gated by GitHub's default `workflow_dispatch` permission (write access to repo). The `environment: production` block enables reviewer requirements if configured. Nothing in this diff changes the trust boundary.

**Other checks:**
- No new secret handling, no new URL/webhook parsing, no new arg interpolation.
- No token exposure changes; env vars unchanged.
- No log/observability sink changes.
- No allowlist/permission-matrix modifications.

The change is a defensive gate to avoid patching Coolify to a nonexistent image tag when no image was built. It does not introduce a new security vulnerability, and the invariant it relaxes ("always pin before trigger") is relaxed only in a scenario where the wait-for-deploy step provides a fail-closed safety net (mismatched SHA → step fails).
